$comment: Defaults for placeholders shared by projects in a track. --print-answers applies them before emitting <FILL:...>. Only project-specific choices remain for the interview. Users may override any answer. Track defaults take precedence over generic defaults.

generic.MIGRATION_NAMING: timestamp + slug (20260916T1200_name.sql); the lead supplies the timestamp in the task, never the developer
generic.REMOTE_URL: (no remote yet; set it after the first push)
generic.RUNTIME_METRICS: none collected yet; add measured telemetry when available
generic.HEAVY_DEPS: none listed yet; add entries when the bundle grows
generic.LEAK_TERMS: none listed yet; name internal terms (tables, columns) that must not leak to clients
generic.INTERNAL_FIELDS: none listed yet; name technical fields that must not appear in public UI
generic.GOLDEN_PATH: define in CLAUDE.md: the main end-to-end user flow
generic.INVARIANTES: define in CLAUDE.md: rules that must never be violated
generic.FORA_DO_MVP: define in CLAUDE.md: work outside the first milestone
generic.CONTEXTO_DE_USO: define in CLAUDE.md: when and how the product is used
generic.CAMADAS: routes → components/hooks → lib (domain) → integrations. Each layer calls only the layer below.
generic.TENANT: single-tenant; adjust for a multi-tenant project

track:mobile-expo.GENERATED_FILES: (no known generated files; adjust if the project uses code generation)

track:unreal-game.CHECK_COMMAND: (see check_runners in scopes.json; depends on UE_ROOT/ENGINE_DIR)
